title: Early prediction of post-dialysis systolic and diastolic blood pressure using intradialytic data in Senegalese hemodialysis patients: a single-center retrospective cohort study.
summary: Random Forest predicted post-dialysis systolic/diastolic pressure from 7,600 sessions in 124 chronic patients using only data through hour three; patient-level five-fold cross-validation gave MAE 12.67±0.80 and 8.93±0.35 mmHg, respectively. Generalization beyond this single center remains untested. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Digital Health. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
